authority: User instruction: pilot is annotation-stage provenance; origin alone does not exclude a review from training, validation, or final test.

rules.if: Used to fit model parameters or fit data-dependent preprocessing in this experiment
rules.then: Cannot serve as untouched validation/final-test evidence for the same fitted model.

rules.if: Supplied as few-shot/demo examples, retrieval reference answers, or used to tune prompts, thresholds, hyperparameters, architecture/model choice or behavior based on inspected performance
rules.then: Do not report those records as untouched FINAL_TEST for that resulting experiment; assign development/train role as appropriate.

rules.if: Only used to formulate annotation definitions or adjudicate labels; no fit, evaluated-prompt examples or performance-based model adaptation
rules.then: Origin is not evidence of target-model leakage. May enter TRAIN, VALIDATION or FINAL_TEST after ordinary split/quality checks.

rules.if: Relevant actual exposure history is unknown
rules.then: NEEDS_EXPOSURE_AUDIT for the intended experiment; do not impose a permanent blanket exclusion.

actual_exposure_gate.new_model_or_separate_api_call: Do not transfer exposure labels merely because the model provider/model family also assisted annotation. Inspect actual trained data, supplied context, prompts and adaptation histories.
actual_exposure_gate.annotation_bias_distinct_from_leakage: AI-assisted labels and purposeful boundary-case sampling may affect reliability/representativeness even without target-model exposure. Report annotation method and sampling honestly.
actual_exposure_gate.fresh_holdout: An independently sampled fresh holdout is recommended when feasible for stronger evidence, not required solely because some reviews originated in an annotation pilot.

related_record_grouping_rule: Keep the same review, revisions, exact duplicates and near-duplicates in one split; these are leakage groups, not blanket exclusions.
complete_review_export_requirements: Current taxonomy and leaf mapping are validated.
Current review and all active targets have the required human adjudication; preserved old flags are not automatically upgraded.
No unresolved HOLD targets remain; do not encode HOLD or missing labels as absence or negative.
Source text, evidence offsets and input requirements are validated.
The intended experiment has a validated exposure history and assigned, non-overlapping splits.

partial_opinion_export.requires: A separately validated partial-label exporter with unresolved-target masks and explicit evaluation coverage.

metadata_assisted_case.direction_rule: This single adjudication is not a rule mapping recommendation to all aspect polarities.
metadata_assisted_case.comparison_rule: All compared models get identical permitted metadata; keep separate from text-only experiments.

no_concrete_evaluation: Confirmed no-aspect reviews may be negative examples for aspect presence; excluded spans are not automatically token-level negative labels.

historical_fields_policy.pilot_exclusion_keys: Historical key inventory for audit/dedup grouping only; not an active origin-based split exclusion.
historical_fields_policy.batch_role: Historical provenance only; old guideline_pilot_not_train_or_final_test values do not override this policy.
historical_fields_policy.learning_eligible: Preserve the archived artifact value. Do not turn it on solely because reuse of pilot origin is allowed; a validated exporter creates experiment-specific eligibility.
historical_fields_policy.review_flags: Do not resolve HOLD, confirm pending reclassification, or change annotation_input by policy migration.

annotation_bias_note: AI-assisted labels and purposeful boundary-case sampling may affect reliability/representativeness even without target-model exposure. Report annotation method and sampling honestly.
